name: decoder_router_hier_topk_exact_v1
hypothesis: Replace the fused route kernel's 256-element tl.topk with four independent 64-expert local top-8 operations and one exact top-8 merge over 32 candidates. Packed keys are unique and encode score plus deterministic expert-ID tie-breaking; the exact global top-8 must lie in the union of group-local top-8 candidates. Preserve all WGS and other incumbent code.
inspiration: vLLM Muse Spark CUDA routing PR #64553, adapting only local-candidate hierarchy; excluding its SM100-only redux.sync.max.f32 fast path.
screen: paired exact-parent H200, all 12 combinations of full/sliding, batch 1/16/32 and q_len 1/8; one seed, eight alternating paired replays; correctness both sides
screen_limit: Fused route consumes about 2 us in incumbent profiles, so realistic full-layer score upside is bounded. Do not submit without repeated positive paired evidence.

official_result.decision_reason: Below 2.26032x incumbent; retain incumbent. The paired H200 effect was too small to survive the official draw.
